ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity (white) to 60% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white patch on the left lobe extending from the mid-proximal to distal region; right lobe features a discrete white island with an internal dark pixel cluster; extensive white mottling along the lower margins above the water line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with sharp peaks along the entire trailing edge; highest amplitude peaks are concentrated on the outer distal margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature on the outer lateral margins, transitioning into an acute upward sweep towards the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A distinct cluster of circular dark-pixel spots centered within the white pigmentation of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle scarring patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of parallel, vertical dark-pixel linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the primary white patch on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple longitudinal rake marks on the left fluke; minor irregular erosion/chipping at the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct 'eye-shaped' pigmentation feature on the right lobe characterized by a dark central focal point surrounded by high-intensity white pixels.
